issue.title: test_ctrl_t_before_reveal_reveals_without_inserting inserts the peeked word under Full CI
issue.description:
Discovered independently by the lander for sase-1kx.5.3.3 while reviewing publication phase sase-1kx.5.3.3.2 note #2. Both observed CI runs used be73b6021ac29d8fcad2cb897192bc6455a47e2b, with no source change between fail and pass. The epic changes nine other visual fixture files, not this node or its implementation.

Full CI 38683274240, Python 3.14 job 116275103637 failed at line 198: after pending=True and ctrl+t, text became Can you help me review the plan instead of staying Can you help me the plan. The later same-SHA Python 3.14 job 116305071922 in Full CI 38698824253 succeeded. This node is distinct from sase-1g8 midword completion; the same root is not established.

Observed pair: 1 failure / 1 pass in full parallel CI. No isolated serial reproduction is claimed. Root cause unproven, so size large is intentional.

Preserve reveal-before-insert semantics. Reproduce the boundary between the delayed reveal timer and dispatch of ctrl+t using controlled scheduling, then fix the proven test or product race without sleeps, longer waits, skip/xfail, or weakening the text assertion.
